messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "children who weigh less than 5.7 pounds (2.6 kg)"
set: ["children who weigh less than 5.7 pounds (2.6 kg)", "should not be used in children who weigh less than 60 kg", "less than two-fold", "children weighing at least 132 pounds (60 kilograms)", "children from birth to less than 18 years of age", "patients less than 3 years", "passing much less urine than usual", "pediatric patients less than 6 years old", "1% to less than 5% of patients", "tell doctor if urinating less than usual", "children younger than 6 months old", "children younger than 7 years old", "children younger than 6 years old", "children younger than 5 years old", "children younger than 2 years old", "children younger than 4 years old"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
